objective: Analyze uncapped stored Train/Validation MLP4/16/two controls across three datasets, identify descriptive common errors and one functionally untried backbone hypothesis; no training decision in this task.
auxiliary_manifest: COVERAGE_AUDIT.json; only pure validation qualification receipts/shards; first512 native rows not representative
coverage_policy: No imputation/new inference for missing MLP16/CurrentOnly Train or MLP4/controls52/62 individual rows. Full Validation endpoint36, full row12cohorts, stratified sample12cohorts and qualification9cohorts reported separately.

predefined_conditions.recent_history_regime: drop if log1p(last)-log1p(mean)<-log(2);rise if>log(2);middle otherwise. Same thresholds as prior analysis.
predefined_conditions.truth_bins: Existing frozen Train quantity bounds per dataset, diagnostic only never model inputs.

new_checks: Absolute error/bias of stored models vs observed-last and observed-mean deterministic references, no inference.
Drop/middle and rise/middle standardization within predefined cells: truthbin;exacttruth;entity×truthbin×activebranches;entity×exacttruth×activebranches.
Common cell mass=min(weighted mass in each regime); both regime distributions standardized to same cells. Row-overlap and equal-entity weighting. Zero-common-support reported N/A.
MLP16−MLP4 seed42 full Validation and AllAvailable−MLP4 weighted Train/Validation paired targets; aux qualification3models512 only.
method_limits: Truth-conditioned strata are retrospective diagnosis, not causal identification/predictive routing.
Matched common-support findings do not apply to excluded targets.
CPU/native provenance and sparse support remain visible.
Prior Test and Cap knowledge already exists; this fresh analysis does not open their files and is exploratory, not blinded confirmation.
No pooled raw metrics across datasets; no p-values, significance or causal attribution.
hypothesis_selection: Choose at most one architecture axis after duplicate audit and actual descriptive evidence. If evidence is limited label design-level only; do not claim causes or force newtraining.
